target.title: fix(imessage): false group drop-all startup warning when groupAllowFrom is set without groups
target.body:
Related: #78749

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators running iMessage with `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` plus a sender allowlist (`channels.imessage.groupAllowFrom`, or the `allowFrom` fallback) but no `channels.imessage.groups` map would see a false startup warning claiming `Every inbound group message will be dropped` — even though group messages flow fine in that configuration via sender-level filtering (`senderFilterBypass` in `src/config/group-policy.ts`).

The warning's remedy text was also wrong for the real drop-all case: it recommended adding `groups["*"]`, but with an empty effective `groupAllowFrom` the sender gate (`group_policy_empty_allowlist`) blocks every group message regardless of `groups` content, so following the advice would not stop the drops.

## Why This Change Was Made

The startup warning now mirrors the runtime gate exactly: `warnGroupAllowlistMisconfigOnce` takes `hasGroupAllowFrom`, computed with the same shared helper (`mergeIMessageGroupAllowFromWithLegacyChatTargets`, now exported) and the same inputs the per-message gate receives, and fires only when both the `groups` registry and the effective group sender allowlist are empty — the only configuration where drop-all is provable at startup (route-level sender allowlists can admit senders later, so any broader condition would reintroduce false positives). The warning text now names `groupAllowFrom` as the actual fix. The stale file-header comment and the two-gate docs section were updated to describe the two warnings' distinct triggers and remedies.

## User Impact

Operators using `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` with `groupAllowFrom` (or the `allowFrom` fallback) and no `groups` map no longer get a misleading warn-level log at every gateway start. Operators in the genuine drop-all configuration now get remediation guidance that actually unblocks group messages.

## Evidence

- False positive confirmed against current gating behavior: `resolveChannelGroupPolicy` admits groups via `senderFilterBypass` (`src/config/group-policy.ts:408`), covered by `extensions/imessage/src/monitor.gating.test.ts` dispatch tests with `groupAllowFrom` set and no `groups`.
- New unit test proves the warning stays silent when `hasGroupAllowFrom` is true, and existing warning tests updated for the new condition/message: `extensions/imessage/src/monitor/group-allowlist-warnings.test.ts` (12 pass).
- Focused suites pass locally via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`: gating + inbound-processing (52 pass), monitor startup paths `monitor.watch-subscribe-retry` / `monitor-provider.echo-cache` / `channel.runtime` (22 pass).
- Remote `check:changed` lane green on Blacksmith Testbox (extensions typecheck, extension-test typecheck, changed-file lint 0 warnings/0 errors, guards), plus `oxfmt --check` clean on the touched files.
- Codex autoreview: one accepted docs finding (first docs draft implied both warnings fire for the same config) fixed; rerun clean — "no accepted/actionable findings".
